entries.auditEvidence: Reviewed for the third PSM review round: webloom.resource.registry keeps kind/id/version 1, is still a local capability with no parser/transfer fields, and its wire DTO is unchanged. Reaching source change is src/contracts/capability.ts: CapabilityBridge gained an optional read-only remoteUnits() projection of the applied peer snapshot (units/instanceId/state), used only to decide whether a private caller's grant record is still live; RpcCallOptions.grantId remains a bounded caller ticket on existing call messages. Neither changes resource registration, resolution, owner semantics or the wire shape of this local contract.
